result.answer:

Pages deployments dropped to about 4% of normal volume, webhook deliveries dropped to about 58% of normal volume, and Code Scanning analyses and Copilot coding agent sessions were delayed. Delayed events were processed after mitigation.

This incident was caused by a configuration change to an internal event-routing service that unexpectedly paused delivery of several event streams. result.answer:
Dựa trên dữ liệu từ công cụ kiểm tra sự cố Cloudflare cho incident `wp49bp8bqo6c`, dưới đây là các thông tin cụ thể:
